description: Remove a peer-review assignment — identified by its assessor_id/user_id pairing — from one submission, unassigning that reviewer; the submission and the assignment itself are untouched, only the peer-review relationship goes away. Returns a confirmation message; Canvas's own response body is discarded. This is a reversible relationship removal, not an irreversible content delete: re-create the assignment with create_peer_review, though the new review gets a new id and workflow_state starts over at "assigned". Find the reviewer's user_id to remove with list_peer_reviews or get_submission_peer_reviews. Requires instructor/TA permission in the course.

user_id.description: The Canvas user ID of the reviewer to remove

name: delete_peer_review
